subject: general
question: When x is added to each of 25, 11, 34 and 13, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 9x : y :: y : (8x - 7) , and y > 0 , what is the value of y?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(25 + x) : (11 + x) :: (34 + x) : (13 + x)

Cross multiply ⇒ (25 + x)(13 + x) = (11 + x)(34 + x)

Simplify ⇒ 325 + 38x + x² = 374 + 45x + x² ⇒ 7x = −49 ⇒ x = −7

Now 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7) ⇒ y² = 9x(8x − 7)

y² = 9(−7)(−63) = 3969 ⇒ y = 63 (since y > 0)

**∴ Answer = 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(25 + x), (11 + x), (34 + x), (13 + x) are in proportion

Also, 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7), y > 0

**Formula used:**

a : b :: c : d ⇒ ad = bc

**Calculation:**

⇒ (25 + x) : (11 + x) :: (34 + x) : (13 + x)

⇒ (25 + x)(13 + x) = (11 + x)(34 + x)

⇒ 325 + 38x + x² = 374 + 45x + x²

⇒ 38x − 45x = 374 − 325

⇒ −7x = 49 ⇒ x = −7

⇒ 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7)

⇒ y² = 9x(8x − 7)

⇒ y² = 9(−7)(−63) = 3969

⇒ y = √3969 = 63 (since y > 0)

**∴ The correct answer is 63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion Rule

If a : b :: c : d then ad = bc (cross multiplication rule)

Quadratic Formation

Equating cross products often cancels x² terms and gives linear equation

Mean Proportion

If a : b :: b : c then b² = ac

Positive Root Condition

If y > 0, take only positive square root
